Not just one usual piece of art, but two in one order. I think you can do it. The first piece is a Remington Model 700 sniper rifle with a full AB Arms body kit, with powerful optic and a silencer. Ergonomics not less than 35, recoil sum - less than 500. And make it lightweight, with a small magazine. The second piece is a Colt M1911 pistol, with a Pachmayr grip, Anarchy Outdoors muzzle brake and a flashlight of any kind.}} ==Objectives== * Modify an [[M700]] to comply with the given specifications * Modify an [[M1911]] to comply with the given specifications ==Rewards== * +28,000 [[EXP]] * 275,000 Roubles ** 288,750 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1 ** 316,250 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2 * 1× [[Pistol case]] * 3× [[7.62x51mm M993 ammo pack (20 pcs)]] {{quote|Okay, I see the bolty, and what about the handgun? There it is, my precious. Good work, friend. The next order is coming in tomorrow, so you can go do your own work until then.}} ==Guide== [[M700]] specifications: * 60 Durability * 35 or more ergonomics * 500 or less recoil * 6 kg or less in weight * 1500 or greater sighting range * A silencer * A magazine with a capacity of 5 or no magazine * [[M700 AB Arms MOD*X GEN 3 chassis]] * [[M700 AB Arms MOD*X GEN 3 KeyMod handguard]] * [[M700 AB Arms MOD*X rail mount]] [[M1911]] specifications: * 60 Durability * 75 or more ergonomics * 200 or greater sighting range * Any [[Weapon mods#Tactical combo devices|tactical device]] (such as the [[NcSTAR Tactical Blue Laser]]) * A magazine * [[M1911 Pachmayr American Legend Grip 423|M1911 Pachmayr American Legend Grip #423]] * [[M1911 Anarchy Outdoors .45 ACP muzzle brake]] ==Builds== ===Notes:=== * These builds are based on a standard [[M700]] from [[Peacekeeper]] LL2 and a standard [[Colt M1911A1 .45 ACP pistol]] from Peacekeeper LL1. * The quest check mark is not consistent even when all requirements are met, it not being present doesn't mean the gun can't be handed over.
